name: Agar
aliases: E406, INS 406, agar, agar-agar, agar agar
what_is: A seaweed-derived polysaccharide used as a gelling, thickening and stabilising food additive, identified in the EU as E406.
why_botia: Agar gels like gelatin but is obtained from algae, so it can replace gelatin in vegan products. The body does not use it as a nutrient: it passes through the digestive tract without being utilised. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical limit, and the label does not say how much it contains.
can_1: Detect E406, agar and agar-agar when declared.
can_2: Trigger texture and E-number information for the ingredient.
cannot_1: Determine concentration, gel strength or raw-material species from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Treat the presence of an authorised texturiser as a risk signal by itself.

sources.label: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 — E406 in the Union list — consolidated 18 August 2026
